class BytesIOCopy:
    """Behaves like ``io.BytesIO`` while also copying everything written
    to another stream, and is backed by a real, ``fileno()``-capable
    file so it can be passed to APIs (like :class:`subprocess.Popen`)
    that require an actual file descriptor.

    .. versionadded:: 8.2

    .. versionchanged:: 8.3.3
        Backed by a temporary file instead of an in-memory buffer so
        that :meth:`fileno` works, fixing ``subprocess`` calls that
        pass a captured stream as ``stdout``/``stderr``. :issue:`2522`
    """

    def __init__(self, copy_to: io.BytesIO) -> None:
        self._file: t.BinaryIO = tempfile.TemporaryFile()
        self.copy_to = copy_to

    def __getattr__(self, name: str) -> t.Any:
        return getattr(self._file, name)

    def write(self, b: ReadableBuffer) -> int:
        self.copy_to.write(b)
        return self._file.write(b)

    def flush(self) -> None:
        self._file.flush()
        self.copy_to.flush()

    def getvalue(self) -> bytes:
        pos = self._file.tell()
        self._file.seek(0)
        data = self._file.read()
        self._file.seek(pos)
        return data
